description: Review declared Kubernetes Service, Deployment, and Ingress relationships with deterministic findings and explicit uncertainty.

defaultPrompt: Review this Kubernetes YAML with Nexo YAML Iron.
What relationships does this Kubernetes manifest actually establish?
Which Kubernetes relationships are unresolved or not realized?
interface.longDescription: Runs Nexo YAML Iron against supplied Kubernetes YAML and presents established relationship findings and explicit unknowns. Detailed inspection is available when deeper evidence is needed. It does not contact or change a cluster.

name: nexo-yaml-iron
